name: Calagopus Auto Backup Tool
description: Create and schedule Calagopus server backups using a client API key. Use help in the console for commands.
author: admin@computerwhz.co.uk

installation.content:
#!/bin/sh
set -eu

cd /mnt/server
apk add --no-cache curl jq

echo "Finding the latest Calagopus backup tool release..."
RELEASE=$(curl --fail --silent --show-error --location https://api.github.com/repos/Computerwhz/Calagopus-Auto-Backup-Tool/releases/latest)
URL=$(printf '%s' "$RELEASE" | jq -r '[.assets[] | select(.name | test("^Calagopus-Auto-Backup-Tool(-[0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]*)?\\.jar$")) | .browser_download_url][0] // empty')

if [ -z "$URL" ]; then
    echo "No Calagopus-Auto-Backup-Tool JAR found in the latest release. Publish the built Calagopus JAR before installing." >&2
    exit 1
fi

TEMP_JAR=$(mktemp ./Calagopus-Auto-Backup-Tool.jar.XXXXXX)
trap 'rm -f "$TEMP_JAR"' EXIT
curl --fail --show-error --location "$URL" -o "$TEMP_JAR"
test -s "$TEMP_JAR"
mv "$TEMP_JAR" Calagopus-Auto-Backup-Tool.jar

echo "Installed:"
ls -lh Calagopus-Auto-Backup-Tool.jar

variables.name: Panel URL
variables.description: Calagopus panel base URL, for example https://panel.example.com (without /api/client).

variables.name: API Key
variables.description: Calagopus client API key with permission to list servers and list, create, and delete backups.
